Workflow.Name: Change Radar: collect web page sections (feeds)
Workflow.Description: Change Radar: collect the active web page section feeds (crdr_feed kind webpage_sections): the Book of News for an event and undated Learn pages such as licensing and billing rates. One signal per heading section; a changed section updates its signal. The first run of a feed is silent (ADR 0018, ADR 0019, spike T11).
